title: Generic crash and casino evaluation notes
notes: Crash-style games typically show a rising multiplier and a cash-out control; the round can end at any time according to the game's RNG or published rules.
Casino lobby categories commonly include slots, live tables, and instant games; exact catalogues change and must be verified in the live lobby.
Bonus offers usually involve wagering requirements, min deposit rules, expiry windows, and game weighting - always read the operator T&Cs.
No provider names, RTP figures, or licence numbers are asserted here without a verified public source in the factual dataset.
